title: Candy Prices, Thanksgiving Tips, and a Deli Comeback
briefing: A little Halloween sticker shock, a holiday hosting guide, a cookbook from the bayou, and a deli legend returns — one of these isn't telling the whole story.

posts.body: Prices for candy, the most popular Halloween purchase, and gum have risen 7.7% in one year.
New recipes and decorating ideas to try this Thanksgiving

Foolproof turkey recipes, hosting advice, AND a stunning floral arrangement guide? This reads like a lifestyle brand press release. “Whether you're hosting friendsgiving or Thanksgiving, we've got foolproof turkey recipes, advice on how to stay present while hosting, and directions on how to create a stunning floral arrangement.”
At Bayou Bar, music and food go hand in hand. Which is why a new cookbook from chef Brian Landry and bandleader Peter Harris has recipes from the menu and stories from the musicians who play there.
